title.narrative: Provision of Operational Support to the Public Information and Affairs Divisions of MONUSCO in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

description.narrative:
During the last weeks of July 2022, violent demonstrations against the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) and the United Nations were organized in North-Kivu and South-Kivu provinces, leading to the death and injury of several demonstrators, MONUSCO peacekeepers as well as the looting and destruction of MONUSCO property in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Butembo, demonstrations have developed into a semi-insurrectional movement with elements of militia groups taking control and carrying out several attacks against civilians, the prison, defense and security forces. These demonstrations were supported by dissemination of false information and hate messages against MONUSCO and several UN agencies operating in the DRC. 

Unprecedented digital attacks targeted the mission, demonstrating a sophisticated, well-planned and well-orchestrated digital campaign from various locations in Eastern DRC, Mali, Europe and North America. It is therefore urgent to strengthen the Mission's digital capabilities, both in terms of human and technical resources, so that it is able to monitor professionally and to both anticipate and react to such attacks.

This Project provides HR support, procurement and fund management services to the MONUSCO Public Information Division Unit and Public Affairs Division in order to enhance its capabilities and scale up its actions and reach to be better prepared to fight false information, prevent and respond to digital attacks, reduce conflicts and achieve peace.
